ORDER RE: CONTINUED (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-26-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-26-2018 BY PRO TEM JEAN MILEFF. 506 PLAINTIFF EUGENE FAYERBERG IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT NICKOLAS JIANG IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: JEAN MILEFF; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUL-26-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FAYERBERG, EUGENE IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT JIANG, NICKOLAS PLAINTIFF ACCEPTED INTERNSHIP WITH DEFENDANT KNOWING HE WOULD RECEIVE NO COMPENSATION. PLAINTIFF WORK WAS WAS TIED TO HIS COURSE WORK + HE EARNED ACADEMIC CREDIT FOR THE HOURS WORKED. PLAINTIFF RECEIVED TRAINING + WAS SUPERVISED BY DEFENDANT. THERE WAS NO EVIDENCE THAT PLAINTIFF DISPLACED ANY EMPLOYEES + THERE WAS NO EVIDENCE THAT PLAINTIFF HAD ANY EXPECTATION OF EMPLOYMENT AT THE CONCLUSION OF THE INTERNSHIP. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $9,940.00 FILED BY FAYERBERG, EUGENE AS TO DEFENDANT JIANG, NICKOLAS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-24-2018 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED OCT-01-2018 ORDERED DESTROYED
